subject: Clarify delivery entrance
text: I live next door to the building your team booked for the weekend delivery, but the label says drop by the back gate, and the code has changed. The courier left a note asking which entrance to use. The package photo only mentions the side door, which is locked before six. Could you clarify whether they should leave it with the concierge or behind the bike shed? If someone gave a different instruction, send the exact wording so I can point to it at the gate. I can step outside during the delivery slot, but only if I know which side of the property I should watch for.
